meta.title: PM Wisdom Map
meta.description: Explore PM insights by archetype, dimension, and sub-theme

operator.name: The Operator
operator.description: Operators focus on processes, scaling, and making teams run smoothly. They think about alignment, coordination, and execution systems.

craftsperson.name: The Craftsperson
craftsperson.tagline: WHAT makes great products and PMs
craftsperson.description: Craftspeople focus on product quality, user experience, and personal excellence. They care deeply about getting the details right.

visionary.name: The Visionary
visionary.tagline: WHY we build and WHERE things are going
visionary.description: Visionaries focus on the future, strategy, and bold bets. They think about market shifts, new categories, and long-term direction.
